release_notes:
- AI: with Nexus-managed AI, the instructions for each AI feature are now assembled on the Nexus server instead of being sent from the app. Improvements to those instructions can reach you without waiting for a new version.
- macOS: the app downloaded from the website is now signed, so macOS remembers your answer when it asks to access your Desktop, Documents or Downloads folder instead of asking again every few seconds. If you update from inside the app, download the app once more from the website to get this fix.
